From Diver Down · Price: the stand has to dive into an object first, and the blow only lands when someone touches it.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 action: your stand dives into an object or surface and stores one Strike for up to 1 hour. The next creature that touches it takes the Strike's damage (no attack roll needed; @Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex} for half). If the stand dives into the ground, wall or gear a creature within its range is touching, the blow lands on that creature at once.
  • 5: The stored blow can be released from up to 10 ft through the object instead. Surge: store @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage instead of a Strike. A creature that fails its save against a stored blow is thrown off its footing: it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} until the end of your next turn.
  • 9: No change.
  • 13: Store two blows in two objects.
  • 17: A creature hit by a stored blow is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} by the object's shape for 1 round (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
